posts.title: And another gear-calculator upgrade!
posts.description: The Gear Calculator has now been upgraded to allow entry of data from a rollout measurement. When you enter rim diameter and tire width, the calculator will automatically give you a rollout number, but you may edit the number to reflect your bicycle’s tire pressure, weight load and tread depth.

posts.title: Upgrade to the Gear Calculator
posts.description: We have upgraded and updated the Gear Calculator. Main improvements: Tire width and rim size are now two separate entries. Pick any tire width rather than being restricted to a list. We have entries for new internal-gear hubs — 3×3 NINE, Kindernay VII, Enviolo. We have added coverage of a few more rim sizes. posts.title: Improved gear graph
posts.description: Our gear-graph article now includes a new, much improved version by Jeremy Mak of the diagram which plots gear ratios of bicycle cassettes and freewheels. His version uses Javascript so you can create a plot for any tooth counts.
